summary: Games Hub player pages now show a real, deterministic avatar for every person/player (boring-avatars, seeded by their stable id — no image storage or fetch), and resolve a player's linked real identity ("This is Aaron Larsen") wherever a steamId is present, in addition to a loading skeleton and a couple of real bugs fixed from live data.
details: New shared PersonAvatar component (boring-avatars) used on the memory page, the players list, player profile headers, and the insights leaderboard.

nora/web/games.py's player-detail payload gains linkedPerson {personId, displayName} when the response's steamId resolves through identity.toml (persons.resolve("pulse", steamId)) — the user<->platform<->game cross-reference confirmed live for miles_novak (熱咖啡) and aaron_larsen (oPineCone).

Fixed a real parse failure: a vitalsHistory point can lack `survival` entirely (observed live on miles_novak's real history, 1/76 points) — PlayerDetailSchema now treats it as optional like the already-optional limbHealth, instead of throwing and blanking the whole player profile page.
Replaced bare 'Loading...' text with a skeleton placeholder on the server detail page.
